query.description:
Supported items for filter: receivedAt, status, type, invoiceId, customerId.

        Filtering parameter in the format "property:rule:value".

        Example: "receivedAt:eq:[some date]" or "status:eq:[some status]".

        For multiple filters use "receivedAt:eq:[some date],status:eq:[some status]".

        Supported rules: eq, neq, gt, gte, lt, lte, like, nlike, in, nin, isnull, isnotnull.

response.name: Get all Payments by filter
